slots.description: Slots must not overlap on the same weekday (ErrOverlappingSlots).

items.description: One weekly slot (gap G29). cutoffLocalTime and departsLocalTime are wall-clock times in the time zone of the lane's origin node, arrivesLocalTime in the time zone of its destination node; the arrival is the first instant after the departure with that wall-clock time.
